_doc: EXAMPLE project-routing config (multi-repo-isolation plan 阶段1). This is a COMMITTED
TEMPLATE showing the schema; the REAL config is deployment-specific (which repo subdirs,
which internal endpoint) and lives at .local/projects.json (gitignored), alongside
.local/deploy-config which already holds REPO_SUBDIR / INDEX_DNS_NAME. Copy this to
.local/projects.json and fill in your deployment's values.
Loaded + validated at gateway startup (bot-gateway/src/project-routing.ts): a bad config
fails the gateway loudly rather than mis-routing at request time.
projects.<projectId> = { endpoint: <CODEGRAPH_MCP_URL for that project's bridge>,
WHICH project a gateway serves is bound by the PROJECT_ID env var (a gateway serves one
Feishu app = one project). If PROJECT_ID is unset AND exactly one project is declared, that
sole project is used (zero-config single-project case). The bot identity (FEISHU_APP_ID) is
NOT in this file — it is env-only, never committed.
Adding a project: add a projects entry in .local/projects.json + set PROJECT_ID on that
project's gateway. repos is forwarded to the agent; per-project endpoint override on the
invoke path lands with the multi-runtime work in 阶段2+ (the live agent reads
CODEGRAPH_MCP_URL from its runtime env today).
